svg.title: Validation of the heater model
svg.desc: The model frozen from the earlier step predicts a step to 90 percent, a step to 65 percent and a 30 kilowatt extra loss within a few thousandths of a degree Celsius; Control Studio scores the two steps, and the load record, which has no command step, is checked by hand. Each record's residuals keep one sign, because the fitted gain is slightly low.
svg.text: The frozen heater model on three records it has never seen
Control Studio recordings · model frozen from the earlier step (K 0.1999 °C/%, L 1 s, τ 5 s) · numbers answer the predictions
No command step: Control Studio cannot score it;
Residuals keep one sign: the fitted gain is 0.05 % low
